components.name: New-WcsSbom.ps1
components.description: dotnet list package plus the hand inventory of embedded components

components.name: @drawio/elk (Eclipse Layout Kernel)
components.copyright: Kiel University and others (Eclipse Layout Kernel contributors)

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The bundle states no licence for @drawio/elk. It contains the ELK layout algorithms (org.eclipse.elk.*), which Eclipse distributes under EPL-2.0. Licence text taken from elkjs 0.11.1 found locally. Which ELK release it was built from is not stated.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: A draw.io package: the bundle states no licence. It contains graphlib, dagre, parts of lodash, layout-base and cose-base (listed separately). Whether it contains code of Mermaid (MIT, Knut Sveidqvist) was not established.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The font file states its copyright but no licence; OFL-1.1 is the licence under which Google Fonts distributes it. OFL text taken from a local copy (Source Sans Pro, in a VS Code extension) without its Adobe header.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The banner says 'See license.txt': that file is not shipped. Apache-2.0 per the linked LICENSE.md.

components.name: CryptoJS
components.copyright: (c) 2009-2013 by Jeff Mott. All rights reserved.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The bundle points to code.google.com/p/crypto-js/wiki/License (offline). The text in licenses/ is the standard BSD-3-Clause wording with Jeff Mott's notice, reconstructed, not copied from the component.

components.name: dagre / @dagrejs/graphlib
components.version: dagre 3.0.0, graphlib 4.0.1 (a second graphlib 2.1.9-pre is also present)

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The bundle says 'For license information please see dagre.min.js.LEGAL.txt' and that file is not shipped. Versions read from version strings in the code.

components.name: draw.io
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2006-2025, JGraph Holdings Ltd; Copyright (c) 2006-2025, draw.io AG

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: js/bootstrap.js was modified by Sun Tech (registers plugins/kazam.js) and carries no Apache-2.0 4(b) change notice of its own; whether other files were changed when the bundle was copied (internal commit 79b88ca9) was not verified file by file against the upstream release.

components.name: draw.io icon sets and stencil libraries
components.copyright: JGraph Holdings Ltd / draw.io AG; vendor icons are trademarks of their owners

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Apache-2.0 as part of draw.io, plus the restriction of img/LICENSE (no use in or for Atlassian products without written permission). Many sets reproduce logos and product icons of third parties (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, IBM, SAP, Atlassian, Dropbox, Google Drive ...).

components.name: JSZip
components.copyright: (c) 2009-2016 Stuart Knightley, David Duponchel, Franz Buchinger, António Afonso

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: LICENSE.markdown taken from JSZip 3.10.1 found locally.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Not listed in the previous NOTICE; identified by their UMD module names. Versions not stated; licence texts from layout-base 1.0.2 and cose-base 1.0.3 found locally.

components.name: libavoid (Adaptagrams), via libavoid-js
components.copyright: libavoid: Monash University and the Adaptagrams contributors

properties.name: wcs:location
properties.value: WCS/Wcs.WebEditor/src/wwwroot/drawio/js/extensions.min.js (initAvoidModule: libavoid compiled to JavaScript with Emscripten)

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Not listed in the previous NOTICE, and the bundle states no licence or copyright for it: identified by its code and by draw.io's comment naming 'libavoid-js 0.5.0-beta.5'. LGPL text taken from Git for Windows (xz, COPYING.LGPLv2.1). The Emscripten runtime around it is MIT OR NCSA (text not included).

components.name: lodash (parts)
components.copyright: Copyright OpenJS Foundation and other contributors

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Version not stated; licence text from lodash 4.18.1 found locally.

components.name: mxGraph (as shipped in draw.io)
components.copyright: Copyright (c) 2006-2017, JGraph Holdings Ltd; Copyright (c) 2006-2017, draw.io AG

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Derived and modified (namespaces, nullable annotations, layout); the export adds the attribution header to the four files.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Neither author nor licence is stated in the bundle. It ships with draw.io (js/orgchart in the draw.io sources); its origin and licence have to be checked there.

components.name: pako
components.copyright: Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn; zlib parts (C) 1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler

properties.name: wcs:location
properties.value: WCS/Wcs.WebEditor/src/wwwroot/drawio/js/app.min.js (and an older copy inside JSZip, js/extensions.min.js)

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The licence texts come from pako 1.0.11 (found locally) and from the zlib licence; the copyright lines of 2.2.0 were not checked against its own LICENSE. The version of the pako copy inside JSZip is not stated.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: Not listed in the previous NOTICE. The bundle carries no banner, version or licence for it: identified by its code. Licence text taken from roughjs 4.6.6 found locally.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: The bundle states only the URL and version; licence and copyright line come from the project, not from the file.

properties.name: wcs:uncertain
properties.value: cola.min.js carries no banner, version or licence. The draw.io adaptor files next to it are draw.io's (JGraph).
